pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo uposathampi na pucchanti ovādampi na yācanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhuniyo uposathampi na pucchissanti ovādampi na yācissantī”ti, …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo uposathampi na pucchanti ovādampi na yācantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo uposathampi na pucchissanti ovādampi na yācissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:1.11.1: “anvaddhamāsaṃ bhikkhuniyā bhikkhusaṅghato dve dhammā paccāsiṃsitabbā – uposathapucchakañca ovādūpasaṃkamanañca taṃ atikkāmentiyā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc59:2.7: uposathampi na pucchissāmi ovādampi na yācissāmīti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
